_meta.description: RSC object ID → RS3 object ID bridge table. Generated from forensic cache analysis.
_meta.coordinateNotes: RSC coordinates: tile origin top-left, approx 0-900 range. RS3 coordinates: tile origin bottom-left, 3000-15000 range. No linear mapping exists — use region labels for cross-era resolution.

mappings.name: Staircase
mappings.notes: RSC 64 is the generic staircase object. RS3 15645 is the modern equivalent in Lumbridge. Multiple RS3 IDs may map from a single RSC ID.

mappings.name: Trapdoor / Cellar entrance
mappings.notes: RSC 57 = cellar trapdoor at Lumbridge. RS3 16543 = modern trapdoor variant.

mappings.name: Ladder (up)
mappings.notes: Generic RSC ladder. RS3 maps to multiple object IDs depending on region.
